Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Sub-THz Sensing for Dynamic Particulate Characterization
  • Host Institution: University of Birmingham
  • Department: Electronic, Electrical and Systems Engineering
  • Research Lab: Microwave Integrated Systems Laboratory (MISL)
  • Industry Partner: Rolls-Royce
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Start Date: 2026/27
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: UKRI rate
  • Eligibility: Strong background in Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science or related
  • Application Deadline: 1 October 2026
  • Contact: Dr Fatemeh Norouzian (f.norouzian@bham.ac.uk) & Prof. Marina Gashinova (m.s.gashinova@bham.ac.uk)

Project Description

This project focuses on developing next-generation smart sensing and data analytics technologies for aerospace applications. The student will investigate novel sensing methods, develop physics-informed computational models, and apply state-of-the-art machine learning techniques to extract useful information from complex measurement data. The project provides access to world-class experimental facilities and close collaboration with industry partners.

Requirements

  • First-class Honours degree (or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a closely related discipline
  • Strong background in radar, microwave engineering, signal processing, electromagnetics, machine learning, or related fields
  • Programming experience in Python and/or MATLAB

How to Apply

Email your CV and a brief statement of research interests to Dr Fatemeh Norouzian and Prof. Marina Gashinova.
